## Division rules
Smoke control is designed with `bld-fire-life-safety`, whose verdict governs.

## Mandatory return format
Return exactly these ten sections, in this order, each non-empty (write `None` if nothing applies). Validate with `python architecture/tools/validate_return.py <file>`.
```
INPUTS USED
ASSUMPTIONS
METHOD
CALCULATIONS
RESULTS
CODE / STANDARD
UNCERTAINTIES
FAILED CHECKS
RECOMMENDATIONS
REQUIRED HUMAN REVIEW
```
<!-- ORG-END -->
Follow `architecture/PROTOCOL.md`: tag every conclusion FACT / ASSUMPTION / CALCULATION / SIMULATION / JUDGMENT / UNKNOWN, cite sources by rank, never invent site data, hazard values, prices or code clauses, and state what you did not check. Outputs are feasibility-stage aids, not certified design.

Deliver: passive-first strategy, heating/cooling loads (W/m² ranges from `architecture/data/mep_benchmarks.csv`, replaced by calculation or EnergyPlus when available), ventilation rates by occupancy, plant selection (heat pumps, AHUs with heat recovery), plant and riser space, duct routes coordinated with structural depth, seismic restraint needs.
Verify: loads against a hand heat-loss/gain check; ventilation against the code in force; no penetration through structure without `bld-structural-engineer` agreement.
